repositories.name: gecko
repositories.setup: Use Gecko's extracted crates in the single Wii OS root Cargo workspace; instruction specs and runtime assets are in the product tree.
repositories.build: cargo build --locked --release -p gecko-app -p tinyapp -p fifoplayer -p debugger -p multitool

repositories.name: gecko-web
repositories.setup: Build the in-product Gecko WebAssembly crate with wasm32-unknown-unknown and wasm-pack; serve generated ES module/WASM over HTTP(S) in a browser with WebGPU.
repositories.gate: Dedicated wasm-pack build; requires wasm32-unknown-unknown, wasm-pack, browser WebGPU support and secure-context hosting.

repositories.name: dolphin
repositories.setup: Use the patched Dolphin source snapshot embedded at src/dolphin; its upstream commit is recorded in SOURCE-REVISION.txt and initialized pinned externals are included locally.
repositories.build: cmake -S src/dolphin -B userland/build/targets/dolphin -G Ninja; cmake --build userland/build/targets/dolphin --parallel
repositories.gate: Validation emulator, not a Wii app compiler; the local source snapshot and required external source trees gate build. Windows builds the Rust-facing in-process ABI DLL.
